name: PronounDB
description: Shows a user's pronouns in their profile, if they've set them at pronoundb.org - see the plugin settings for details.
note: Previously broken because PronounDB shut down the API it used (HTTP 410) - migrated to their current v2 API. Requires people to have set pronouns at pronoundb.org; nothing to configure in the plugin itself.

name: RoleColorEverywhere
description: Displays a member's top role color in more places: mentions, the typing indicator, voice channel participant names, member list role headers, and optionally message text.
note: Previously broken. Ported from the original source and hardened with the same crash-isolation fix as Staff Tags.

name: Staff Tags
description: Adds customizable tags (OWNER, ADMIN, STAFF, MOD, and more) next to members based on their server permissions. Supports per-tag colors, gradients, custom text, and visibility toggles.
note: Previously broken. Rebuilt with per-patch crash isolation, plus new customization: per-tag text, colors, gradients, and visibility.

name: Message Snippets
description: Save reusable text and send it with /snippet <name>. Manage snippets from the plugin settings, or with /snippet-save, /snippet-delete, /snippet-list.
note: Didn't exist in the Revenge/Vendetta plugin ecosystem before.

name: Reminders
description: Set quick reminders with /remind <time> <text>, e.g. /remind 20m Walk the dog. Fires while Discord is running in the foreground or background - it can't wake the app up if it's been fully closed.
note: Didn't exist in the Revenge/Vendetta plugin ecosystem before. Only fires while Discord is running.
